uncovered_gaps: PrivacyMode has no distinct transport effect: PUBLIC and PRIVATE both collapse to NetworkType::P2P self-signed certs (node_bringup.rs:93-103), and Anonymous merely toggles FALCON off — the wire-level meaning of the three privacy modes and what authenticates an Anonymous peer at all is unfiled, yet the whole architecture rests on PrivacyMode being independent of BlockchainScope.

The auth/ module (types + middleware) is built but its enforcement is honestly inert — the issuer is always None (per dormant-wiring summary) — so the HTTP/middleware authentication layer is disabled on the live path with no dedicated finding.

DaemonState carries several built-but-None seams beyond the --mode flag (W2-89): light_sync_manager (light client), release_feed subscriber, and transfer_coordinator (Phase-G inert in both DaemonState and PeerContext) — these dormant seams are noted in summaries but none is filed as its own gap.

The sync-fetch wire uses from_height range slicing (blockchain-core summary calls it a residual single-spine assumption) — whether range-based block fetch is even coherent against the canonical per-asset/independent-chain model was never examined by any finding, and it underlies cluster A's sync design.

The `base` crate is an unwired substrate scaffold with todo!() bodies (per project memory) yet is the canonical home of derive_cell/derive_address/AssetAddress that live blockmatrix code re-implements (base/src/address.rs is referenced by W2-56/W1-9 only in passing) — reconciling base/ as the shared-geometry source of truth is unfiled.

Caesar's coin/wallet economics beyond the mock staking API (W2-9): economic.rs's descriptive Decimal wallet fields (initialized to zero, never gated) — whether the broader Caesar economic layer is scar to delete or planned CAESAR-reward machinery is unadjudicated.

R16 link-sovereign interface management (os_integration) is not exercised by any finding — whether the shipped node actually enumerates interfaces and re-selects address/coordinate + signals connection migration on a real link change is unverified end-to-end.
